sub: No more manual bag checks at
paragraphs: PM Shehbaz Sharif has ordered smart **scanners** at all of Pakistan's international airports to make travel easier for passengers.
The scanners will be imported **immediately** so bags can be checked electronically instead of being opened by hand by customs staff.
Customs officials have been told not to question passengers **unnecessarily** and the PM's office said no one will be allowed to harass travellers.
Airport service staff will also get training to **international** standards, with courtesy and respect at its core.
